My trial was a quick one…
Lawyer told me to take the deal from the DA.
Whole affair got pretty big news coverage and even some politicians, especially the DA, who thought of it as a great way to boost his position, took a shot at me and called me all kinds of stuff on live tv.
I was sentenced to 20 years of forced community work in a government facility with restricted movement.
That’s how prisons are called nowadays.
